learning_outcomes.text: choose and apply methods to problems within all parts of the course, as they are described in the course content
present and justify solutions to tasks within the course content using relevant concepts and clear reasoning

syllabus_topics: Basic properties of subsets of R^n and functions of several variables, derivatives.
Real- and vector-valued functions of several variables.
Gradients with applications, local extrema and inverse and implicitly given functions
Gradient, normal, tangent and tangent plane.
Inverse the function theorem and the implicit function theorem.
Area, volume, mass and center of mass.
assessment_rules: Grades for examination modules are decided in accordance with the assessment criteria presented at the start of the course. The grading scale is U, 3, 4, 5.
bibliography: Course material available on the course web site.
degree: Industrial Engineering and Management - International (6CIEI), terms 1-6 (first cycle)
